package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/queryfields"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/transport/http/api/v1/middleware"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/transport/http/api/v1/parsers"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/contentaccess"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/lesson"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"github.com/go-playground/validator/v10"
)

// LessonHandler handles lesson endpoints.
type LessonHandler struct {
	Validator   *validator.Validate
	GetUC       lesson.GetLesson
	ListUC      lesson.ListLessonsByCourse
	MaterialsUC lesson.GetLessonMaterials
	Access      contentaccess.Service
}

// List returns lessons for a course id.
func (h LessonHandler) List(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	courseID := chi.URLParam(r, "courseID")
	fieldsParam := r.URL.Query().Get("fields")

	// Parse and validate fields
	f := queryfields.Parse(fieldsParam, queryfields.LessonAllowedFields)
	responseIncludesID := f.Has("id")
	queryFields := f.Including("id")

	// Parse filters and sort from query parameters
	filters, err := parsers.ParseLessonFilters(r, h.Validator)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	sort := parsers.ParseSortOptions(r)

	if courseID != "" {
		if filters.CourseID != nil && *filters.CourseID != courseID {
			http.Error(w, "course_id does not match path", http.StatusBadRequest)
			return
		}
		filters.CourseID = &courseID
	} else if filters.CourseID != nil {
		courseID = *filters.CourseID
	}

	_, role, authenticated := middleware.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	privileged := authenticated && isPositionPrivilegedRole(role)
	if !privileged {
		active := domain.LessonStatusActive
		filters.Status = &active
		switch {
		case filters.CourseID != nil:
			err = h.Access.RequireCourse(r.Context(), *filters.CourseID)
		case filters.ModuleID != nil:
			err = h.Access.RequireModule(r.Context(), *filters.ModuleID)
		case filters.SectionID != nil:
			err = h.Access.RequireSection(r.Context(), *filters.SectionID)
		default:
			err = domain.ErrNotFound
		}
		if err != nil {
			writeContentAccessError(w, err)
			return
		}
	}

	lessons, total, err := h.ListUC.HandleWithFields(r.Context(), courseID, queryFields, filters, sort)
	if err != nil {
		if err == domain.ErrNotFound {
			http.Error(w, "not found", http.StatusNotFound)
			return
		}
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}

	// Ensure we return empty array instead of null
	if lessons == nil {
		lessons = []map[string]any{}
	}
	if !privileged && len(lessons) > 0 {
		lessonIDs := make([]string, 0, len(lessons))
		for _, item := range lessons {
			if lessonID, ok := item["id"].(string); ok && lessonID != "" {
				lessonIDs = append(lessonIDs, lessonID)
			}
		}
		decisions, err := h.Access.ResolveLessons(r.Context(), lessonIDs, false)
		if err != nil {
			writeContentAccessError(w, err)
			return
		}
		for _, item := range lessons {
			lessonID, _ := item["id"].(string)
			decision, ok := decisions[lessonID]
			if !ok {
				decision.Effective = domain.DefaultLessonReadAccess
			}
			item["effective_read_access"] = decision.Effective
			item["can_read"] = decision.CanRead
			if decision.SourceType != "" {
				item["read_access_source_type"] = decision.SourceType
			}
			if !decision.CanRead {
				delete(item, "description")
				delete(item, "translations")
				delete(item, "compose_config")
			}
			if !responseIncludesID {
				delete(item, "id")
			}
		}
	} else if !responseIncludesID {
		for _, item := range lessons {
			delete(item, "id")
		}
	}

	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{
		"lessons": lessons,
		"meta":    buildPaginationMeta(filters.Page, filters.Limit, total),
	})
}

// Get handles GET /lessons/{lessonID}.
func (h LessonHandler) Get(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	lessonID := chi.URLParam(r, "lessonID")
	var readDecision contentaccess.LessonReadDecision
	if !isPrivilegedRequest(r) {
		var err error
		readDecision, err = h.Access.AuthorizeLesson(r.Context(), lessonID, r.URL.Query().Get(relationAccessQueryParam))
		if err != nil {
			writeContentAccessError(w, err)
			return
		}
	} else {
		readDecision = contentaccess.LessonReadDecision{Effective: domain.DefaultLessonReadAccess, CanRead: true}
	}
	fieldsParam := r.URL.Query().Get("fields")

	// Parse and validate fields
	f := queryfields.Parse(fieldsParam, queryfields.LessonAllowedFields)

	result, err := h.GetUC.HandleWithFields(r.Context(), lessonID, f)
	if err != nil {
		if err == domain.ErrNotFound {
			http.Error(w, "not found", http.StatusNotFound)
			return
		}
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	result["effective_read_access"] = readDecision.Effective
	result["can_read"] = readDecision.CanRead
	if readDecision.SourceType != "" {
		result["read_access_source_type"] = readDecision.SourceType
	}

	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(result)
}
